title: Segata Sanshirou: Shinken Yuugi
native_title: せがた 三四郎 ～真剣遊戯～
overview: Segata Sanshirou Shinkenyugi is a game starring popular Segata Sanshiro, a fictional character created by Sega to advertise the Sega Saturn in Japan between the years 1997 and 1998. This game could be defined a miscellaneous, and much in the line with the WarioWare series (except for the multiplayer option, which this game does not have), where what we do is taking part in several mini games, all of them based in the TV adverts Segata Sanshiro protagonized. They will range from side-scrolling platformers to puzzles, button smashing or memory games, and if you finish them correctly, it would unlock the video clip of the commercials each mini game was based in. Also, radio advertisements and other hidden bonuses have been included.
